question: Should main-session `sessions_yield` be represented in persisted/Gateway/UI session rows as `status: "paused"` with `pauseReason: "sessions_yield"` now, or should this PR wait and align with the broader yielded-parent lifecycle vocabulary first?
rationale: The code path now appears coherent, but adding a durable public-ish status value is a product and compatibility contract choice that source review cannot settle unilaterally.

options.title: Accept paused contract now
options.body: Land this narrow repair with the new `paused`/`pauseReason` row contract and treat any later vocabulary change as a mechanical follow-up.

options.title: Align naming before merge
options.body: Ask the contributor to rename or adapt the session-row status to the maintainer-chosen yielded-parent vocabulary before exposing it through persistence, Gateway payloads, and UI types.

options.title: Hold for broader lifecycle work
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers want https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95996 or a successor to own the permanent yielded-parent lifecycle contract.

recommendation.title: Accept paused contract now
recommendation.body: Land this narrow repair with the new `paused`/`pauseReason` row contract and treat any later vocabulary change as a mechanical follow-up.

likelyOwner.reason: The prior yielded subagent pause fix is the closest merged precedent for the contract this PR extends to main sessions.
